description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the remaining ConsoleArguments VT-handle semantics with a dedicated safe Rust owner and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: The safe VtHandlePair owner reproduces Microsoft's HasVtHandles matrix: both input and output must be non-null and different from INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE.

The safe raw-command-line aggregate preserves externally supplied VT input/output handles unchanged while parsing a command line with no VT mode switch, matching Microsoft's constructor-plus-ParseCommandline observable.
The portable handle predicate treats both zero and pointer-sized -1 as invalid and positive handle values as valid, exactly matching Microsoft's IsValidHandle vectors.
